description: Exact signature fixtures for the published bindings, rotation and revocation, under one contract: FIPS 204 / FIPS 205 pure mode, empty context, message = the 32 raw bytes named in each case. The message is recomputed from the statement (direct route) or from the carrier (carrier-bound route), never taken from message_hex alone; message_hex is there for comparison. Every case carries negative controls that must not verify. The source records are unchanged; this file only collects their bytes.

contract.message: 32 raw bytes (never the hex string, never a pre-hash variant)

cases.role: continuity: the predecessor PQ key authorizes its successor

negative_controls.note: FIPS 204/205 require a pre-hash at least as strong as the parameter set; a 192-bit set may refuse SHA-256 outright.
The UTF-8 bytes of the message's hex string instead of the 32 raw bytes.
First byte of the message flipped.
First byte of the signature flipped.

cases.role: possession: the new PQ key signs its own binding

negative_controls.note: FIPS 204/205 require a pre-hash at least as strong as the parameter set; a 192-bit set may refuse SHA-256 outright.
The UTF-8 bytes of the message's hex string instead of the 32 raw bytes.
First byte of the message flipped.
First byte of the signature flipped.

cases.role: revocation: the revoked binding's PQ key authorizes the revocation

negative_controls.note: FIPS 204/205 require a pre-hash at least as strong as the parameter set; a 192-bit set may refuse SHA-256 outright.
The UTF-8 bytes of the message's hex string instead of the 32 raw bytes.
First byte of the message flipped.
First byte of the signature flipped.

cases.role: genesis possession through a carrier: the PQ key signs the Nostr event that carries the statement
cases.source: the live binding document published by the statement's owner (pq-key-binding-v0.vectors.json, first vector, pins the statement and event id)

carrier.link: sha256(content) == sha256(JCS(statement)); message = event id = sha256(JSON [0, pubkey, created_at, kind, tags, content])

cases.message: the Nostr event id, 32 raw bytes
